name: Aquila Pipeline (Eagle Mountain)
researcher_notes: No existing row matches. The nearby Utah rows are the MountainWest Goshen expansions and the Magnum storage header line, which are different lines. Williams spring 2026 shipper board slides describe a 19 mile service pipeline from MountainWest to the Aquila power plant at Eagle Mountain, Utah. A Utah Public Service Commission notice from November 2025 says Will-Power UT LLC, owned by Williams, will build and own a 20 mile service pipeline to the plant and is still acquiring permits. The Williams customer meeting slides from March 2026 give a 12.5 year agreement and in-service dates in the second half of 2027 and first half of 2028. Length is staged as 19 miles from the Williams slides; the commission notice says about 20. Status is proposed because permits were still being acquired. Proposal year is the year of the commission notice. DataCenter is left blank. A local article ties the plant to the Meta campus, but it does not name the pipeline, and the commission notice only says the customer's industrial property. No route was found. The Williams slides also show a 1 mile service pipeline from Kern River to the plant. It has no source beyond the slides and no data center tie, and it is under 25 km, so it should not get its own row for now. Williams slides give no pipe diameter, capacity or cost. Confidence is medium: two Williams documents plus a state regulator filing, but the Williams documents come from one company.
